chapter_summary: Gu Suizhou visits Leapton at his internet cafe, revealing he has run away from Lin Sui's home and is now freeloading off someone (implied to be Shen Feizhi). Leapton, a flamboyant character, is also revealed to be Gu Suizhou's partner in an ongoing investigation. Shen Feizhi arrives at the internet cafe, needing a private room for two hours. It's revealed he arrived in 'this world' a week ago and is gathering information about key figures like Lin Sui, Gu Suizhou, and Lin Zhou, and the organization W.N. He is also implied to be working under a tight schedule, possibly as a janitor at W.N. Gu Suizhou tasks Leapton with investigating the Shen family's financial transactions related to drug funding and finding his parents' bodies, who died in an accident years ago, implicating the Shen family. Gu Suizhou also reveals he has made advances on Shen Feizhi, who was indifferent, and plans a new approach. Leapton, meanwhile, is smitten with Shen Feizhi.
